$description: CRA design tokens. Source of truth. Token keys ARE the CSS custom property names (without --). primitive.* = raw values named by value, NEVER used in components. semantic.* = named by usage, reference a primitive with {name}; the only tokens components may use. Semantic colors and shadows have a 'light' and a 'dark' value. Mirror every change in tokens.css.

font-family-mono.$value: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

color-surface.$description: Default surface: cards, header, table, inputs, calendar day cells.

color-surface-muted.$description: Subtle surface: table header, summary bar, code, sunken areas.

color-surface-hover.$description: Hover background for rows, ghost buttons, nav links, empty day cells.

color-border.$description: Decorative dividers and card borders (no contrast requirement).

color-border-strong.$description: Borders of interactive controls (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons). >= 3:1 on surface and bg.

color-text.$description: Body text and headings on bg, surface, surface-muted, surface-hover, surface-overlay.

color-text-muted.$description: Secondary text (help, captions, table meta) on bg, surface, surface-muted. >= 4.5:1.

color-text-disabled.$description: Disabled labels and out-of-month day numbers (exempt from contrast).

color-text-link.$description: Inline links on bg and surface.

color-primary.$description: Accent fill: primary button, active nav marker, selected state, worked day.

color-primary-subtle.$description: Tinted background: active nav item, selected row, info about the current client.

color-text-primary.$description: Accent text on bg, surface and color-primary-subtle.

color-border-primary.$description: Accent border: selected control, today ring.

color-focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring (solid, >= 3:1 on every surface).

color-success-text.$description: Success text and icon on color-success-bg, surface, bg.

color-warning-text.$description: Warning text and icon on color-warning-bg, surface, bg.

color-error-text.$description: Error text and icon on color-error-bg, surface, bg (validation messages).

color-error-solid.$description: Destructive button fill and invalid field border.

color-info-text.$description: Info text and icon on color-info-bg, surface, bg.

color-day-worked-bg.$description: Full worked day fill; also the filled triangle of a half day.

color-day-worked-text.$description: Day number and label on color-day-worked-bg.

color-day-half-bg.$description: Half day: light half behind the day number.

color-day-weekend-text.$description: Day number on a weekend cell.

color-day-holiday-text.$description: Holiday label and day number on color-day-holiday-bg.

color-day-off-hatch.$description: Diagonal hatch stripes on a leave/absence cell.

color-day-today-inverse-bg.$description: Disc behind today's number when today is worked (on color-day-worked-bg).

color-day-outside-text.$description: Day number of days outside the displayed month.

color-paper-bg.$description: CRA sheet background (screen preview and print). Stays white in dark theme.

color-paper-text.$description: CRA sheet text: always black, prints crisp in black and white.

color-paper-text-muted.$description: CRA sheet secondary text (labels, hints) on color-paper-bg.

color-paper-rule.$description: CRA sheet table rules and signature boxes (>= 3:1 on paper).

color-paper-fill.$description: CRA header/total row fill. Browsers may drop it: never the only cue.

color-paper-accent.$description: CRA eyebrow text; prints as dark gray in B&W (>= 4.5:1 on paper).

elevation-flat.$description: Cards, tables, calendar: flat, separated by color-border.

space-inline-xs.$description: Gap between an icon and its label inside badges/tags.

space-inline-sm.$description: Gap between an icon and its label in buttons, between inline controls.

space-inline-md.$description: Gap between buttons in a group, between toolbar items.

space-stack-xs.$description: Label to input, title to subtitle.

space-stack-sm.$description: Input to help/error text, items in a tight list.

space-stack-md.$description: Between form fields, paragraphs, card sections.

space-stack-lg.$description: Between page blocks (page header to content).

space-inset-xs.$description: Padding of tiny elements (tooltip vertical, badge vertical).

space-inset-sm.$description: Padding of compact elements (day cell, tag).

space-inset-md.$description: Padding of cards, toasts, table cells (horizontal).

space-inset-lg.$description: Padding of modals, page sections, empty states.

space-inset-xl.$description: Padding of the CRA sheet preview on screen.

space-control-x-md.$description: Horizontal padding, medium controls and inputs.

space-print-cell-y.$description: Vertical padding of CRA table cells (fits a full month on one A4 page).

space-print-section.$description: Gap between blocks of the CRA sheet.

radius-control.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects, checkboxes, day cells.

radius-card.$description: Cards, tables, calendar, toasts, summary bar.

font-family-numeric.$description: Totals, day counts, SIRET, dates in tables.

font-size-display.$description: Display: calendar month title on desktop, empty-state hero.

font-size-heading-2.$description: Section title (h2), modal title, summary total.

font-size-small.$description: Help text, table meta, small buttons, badges.

font-size-caption.$description: Captions, day labels (Férié, ½), weekday headers on mobile.

line-height-control.$description: Single-line controls (height is set by size-control-*).

line-height-print.$description: CRA sheet text (compact, fits a month on one page).

letter-spacing-caps.$description: Uppercase eyebrows and role labels (CRA sheet).

border-width-strong.$description: Selected/today ring, active nav underline, half-day border.

size-icon-sm.$description: Icons in small buttons, badges, inline text.

size-control-md.$description: Height of medium buttons, inputs, selects.

size-touch-target.$description: Minimum hit area on touch devices (mobile nav, day cells).

size-field-min-width.$description: Min width of a column in a multi-column form row.

size-hatch-stripe.$description: Stripe width of the leave/absence hatch pattern.

size-hatch-gap.$description: Repeat period of the leave/absence hatch pattern.

size-note-dot.$description: Diameter of the 'has note' dot on a day cell (mobile).

size-link-underline-offset.$description: Distance between inline link text and its underline.

size-sheet-width.$description: A4 sheet width (screen preview and print).

size-sheet-padding.$description: Inner margin of the A4 sheet preview on screen (mirrors @page margin).

size-print-margin.$description: Documented value of @page margin (literal in @page, see print.md).

duration-spinner.$description: One rotation of the loading spinner.

z-sticky.$description: Sticky table headers, calendar weekday row.

z-header.$description: App header and mobile bottom nav.

z-toast.$description: Toast stack (dialogs use the top layer, no z-index).

breakpoint-mobile.$description: max-width: 47.99rem  -> phones: bottom nav, stacked tables, compact calendar.

breakpoint-small.$description: max-width: 29.99rem  -> small phones: weekday initials only.
